description.narrative: Youth For Christ Denmark is part of a global network of youth organisations that all have a similar foundation for their activities and work. A project group has been created from the YFC Denmark local group in Herning. The project group would like to investigate the possibility of launching a Rock Solid children?s club in Georgia with YFC Georgia. Rock Solid is one of the longest standing activities and departments of Youth For Christ Denmark and is centred around creating youth focussed activities that engage local volunteers and create a space for young people to grow, lead and be supported in being an influence in their communities. The plan is for the project group to travel to Georgia in November and to meet with Youth For Christ Georgia and their current team with volunteers and workshop the idea together to see if a pilot project is achievable and what it could look like.
